bead.title: Re-evaluate log-then-apply upsert/update_fields/reschedule ban under universal commit ordering
bead.description: ADR-013 (amended 2026-07-05) makes commit ordering universal: log durable -> serving projection applied -> ack. On objectlog/hybrid the serving (memory) projection applies synchronously before ack, so the projection a claim or upsert validates against is current — the upsert-vs-lagging-projection race that motivated TD-007 §2.2's blanket '-ERR pqueue unavailable' for upsert/update_fields/reschedule on the log-then-apply class may now be closable on hybrid profiles. This matters for 7thsense: mutable schedules (FR-46, ingest-then-reschedule) are core to scheduled delivery, and today they are unavailable on the flagship S3-durable profile, forcing atomic-class backends. Decide per profile: which log-then-apply compositions can validate pre-commit against a synchronously-applied serving projection and safely lift the ban; update TD-007 §2.2, TD-006 flavor-difference 5, TD-004, and API-003's scheduled-delivery profile accordingly. If the ban stays for any profile, record the 7thsense topology consequence (mutable-schedule queues must run atomic-class) explicitly in API-003.
bead.acceptance: TD-007/TD-006/TD-004 state per-profile upsert/update_fields/reschedule availability with rationale; the upsert-claim race argument is re-derived under the universal ordering; either the hybrid ban is lifted with conformance scenarios covering upsert-during-claim under group commit, or API-003 records the atomic-class requirement for mutable-schedule queues; cascade re-stamped, ddx doc stale clean.
